observability.title: Overview
observability.description: Follow current capacity, finished executions, and outstanding alerts across the organization.
observability.errorHint: Refresh to check the source again. Missing data does not mean there are no problems.
observability.windowHint: The end is exclusive. Enter timestamps with UTC or an explicit offset; timezone controls reporting boundaries and display.
observability.liveHint: Queue and installation counts reflect the latest snapshot, independently of the selected completion window.
observability.finishedHint: Success rate is completed ÷ (completed + failed). Cancelled and unfinished executions are shown separately.
observability.tokensHint: Token counts include reported usage from failed executions. They are not a bill or an estimated charge.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Investigate fixed-rule alerts, record ownership, and track recovery separately from acknowledgement.
alerts.activeNotice: By default, all active alerts are shown, including those first seen before the reporting window.
alerts.subject: Subject
alerts.ownerHint: Only active administrators with completed password setup are eligible.
alerts.moreOwners: More administrators match. Refine the search.
alerts.acknowledgeNotice: Acknowledgement records that someone is investigating. It does not mean the condition recovered.
alerts.assignNotice: Assignment changes responsibility for this alert. It does not change the underlying execution.
alerts.closeNotice: Close with a reason and a disposition. A failed execution remains a historical failure.

rules.queue_timeout: Execution queued for over five minutes

health.title: Service health
health.description: Source observations and detector freshness. Unavailable telemetry is not evidence that every installation is offline.

settings.title: Deployment settings
settings.description: Read-only settings supplied by the deployment. Changes are made through deployment configuration.
settings.retentionHint: Unconfigured values are unknown. Engineering targets are not enforced retention policies.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Organization membership and execution metadata. Private workspace configuration remains restricted.
workspaces.name: Workspace

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Append-only administrative activity and controlled state changes.
audit.snapshotUnknown: Historical actor name was not captured
